page.overview:
What is Map?

A map is an item used to view explored terrain and mark landmarks.

When the player first creates a map, it is blank. It needs to be activated by holding it and pressing . after which it records terrain and location markers as the player travels within (or close to) the area it maps.

This variation is called an "empty map". It does not show location markers. It is intended for cloning and zooming locator maps without having to consume an additional compass (thereby saving iron ingots and redstone dust), but it can also be and later converted to a locator map by combining it with a compass on an anvil, crafting table, or cartography table.

A map can also be created using a single paper on a cartography table to create an empty map, or a paper with a compass for an empty locator map.
